contributions.statement: When a spec has concrete acceptance examples, commit them to the workspace as runnable fixtures (request/response or input/output JSON plus a runner script) before the agent starts rather than leaving them in prose or chat answers; giving the same examples as runnable files raised overall pass from 37.4% to 61.8% while recovered-constraint coverage stayed flat.
contributions.evidence: Table IX, §IV-C2: GLM-5.1 think-8k on ICAE-Bench-Lite. With Public case files, overall 61.8 vs 37.4 and coverage 61.2 vs 63.8; the gain extends to hidden Native and Enhanced cases. One model, one run, the 50 smallest repositories, greenfield builds.

contributions.statement: After clarification, rewrite the answers into one coherent spec document before implementation instead of appending the question-and-answer transcript to the original request, because with every recoverable answer appended four of six models still scored below the coherent full spec.
contributions.evidence: §IV-B, Fig. 6 (figure-only, no numbers in text): RecoveredPRD below GroundPRD for GPT-5.5, Claude-Opus-4.8, GLM-5.1 and Sonnet 4.6; Gemini-3.1-Pro and MiniMax are exceptions. Lite split, single runs.

contributions.statement: Size an agent's clarification budget to the number of open ambiguity points rather than minimising it, since halving the budget from 16 to 8 questions (for about 20 ambiguity points per task) cut pass from 37.4% to 22.9%, while raising it to 24 gave no further gain (34.4%).
contributions.evidence: Fig. 10, §IV-C5: GLM-5.1 think-8k on Lite, coverage 57.9 -> 71.4 across budgets. Single run and one model; the 16 -> 24 dip is within plausible noise. There is no zero-question arm.

reason: The leaderboard itself adds nothing actionable, but one controlled intervention survives. Holding requirement content fixed, delivering acceptance examples as runnable files rather than conversational answers moved pass by 24 points. That is a direct, if single-model, refinement of test-first practice for spec-driven handoffs. The transcript-versus-coherent-spec and budget findings stay weak.
